verdict.rationale: Saved-host, one-tap SSH connection is a fair question for an iOS terminal app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents SSH host profiles or stored credentials. The only nearby features are directory bookmarks (`bookmark`/`jump`), toolbar configuration and the `.profile` startup script, which are adjacent features or user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to a saved host with one tap without re-entering credentials
